November 25, 2026


Congratulations to the people of Wollaston Lake and Hatchet Lake Denesuline First Nation on the recent opening of Highway 995, creating year-round road access and a new connection to Saskatchewan’s provincial highway network. This 102-kilometre all-season road represents decades of vision, determination and collaboration. Most importantly, it will create new connections and opportunities for generations to come. To the communities and everyone who helped make this milestone possible, bravo!
